content: MediaRecorder: Safari historically records mp4 (H.264/AAC); Safari 18.4+ adds WebM/Opus recording; Chrome records webm/opus and newer versions fMP4; fragmented MP4 lacks duration (Infinity); iOS 26 had timeslice<=100ms empty-blob bug (fixed). Safari plays WebM via own demuxer but behavior varies by version. Recommendation: feature-detect with isTypeSupported, use recorder.mimeType, server-side ffmpeg normalize to AAC m4a / H.264 mp4 faststart.
